title: When to Take Out a Debt Consolidation Loan
excerpt: Debt consolidation can be a helpful financial tool when used correctly. Here's what you need to know about when it's appropriate to consider a debt consolidation loan.
imageAlt: R100 notes coming out of an ATM

body.text: Debt consolidation can be a helpful financial tool when used correctly. Here's what you need to know about when it's appropriate to consider a debt consolidation loan:
Signs You Might Need Debt Consolidation

items: You're struggling to keep track of multiple payment dates
Your current interest rates are higher than consolidation loan rates
You have a stable income to make regular payments

body.text: When done correctly, debt consolidation can offer several advantages:

items: Single monthly payment instead of multiple payments

body.text: Debt consolidation isn't always the best solution. Avoid it if:

items: Your total debt is small and manageable
You can't qualify for a lower interest rate
You haven't addressed the root cause of your debt

body.text: Steps Before Taking a Consolidation Loan

items: Compare interest rates from different lenders
Create a budget to ensure you can make payments
Develop a plan to avoid accumulating new debt
